description: Compares the running frontend version with the backend-required frontend version from system stats and shows the dismissible mismatch warning toast.

characterizationScenarios.name: Version mismatch between frontend and backend raises one dismissible warning

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
